fact: NISA officers arrested activist Sadia Moalin Ali on 12 April 2026 after a tuk-tuk drivers' protest, and on 1 June 2026 she was charged in the Banadir Regional Court with insulting government institutions and public incitement over her social media criticism of the government; five journalists were also arrested on 6-8 May 2026 and released.
title: Journalist killed, others arrested while on duty
